areas.name: Hollowreach Vale
areas.subtitle: A village that has learned to sleep lightly, and the vale around it.

areas.name: The Wakewood
areas.subtitle: Old trees that were never felled, and a stair going down among the roots.

areas.name: Greenmoor
areas.subtitle: Fields that stopped being fields, and nobody came back for them.

areas.name: The Drowned Flats
areas.subtitle: Shallow water over a road, and the tops of walls still showing.

areas.name: Emberfall Basin
areas.subtitle: Built in the ribs of something older, down in the bowl of it.

areas.name: The Kiln Terraces
areas.subtitle: Cut steps, fired brick, and two ways down into the dark.

areas.name: The Windward Downs
areas.subtitle: Pasture that is still being kept, by somebody, for something.

areas.name: The Rimefell
areas.subtitle: Above the last of the trees. The wolves here hunt in threes.

areas.name: Wakewood Crypt
areas.subtitle: Something under the wakewood is breathing again.

areas.name: The Stonecount Barrow
areas.subtitle: They counted the ones who did not come back, and then they stopped.

areas.name: The Glasswork
areas.subtitle: They fired something here that was not brick.

areas.name: The Ashen Deep
areas.subtitle: The road down, and the warden that keeps it.

areas.name: The Mirror Sanctum
areas.subtitle: It has been watching you the whole way here.

areas.name: The Proving
areas.subtitle: Nothing here is real. Nothing here counts.

lines: You have your mother's stubborn walk, Wanderer.
The crypt under the wakewood has been breathing again. Three of ours went in.
Only one thing came back, and it wasn't one of ours. Go and see.
North over the Rootbridge, and keep to the path. The trees there are older than the village.
npcs.name: Elder Mara

lines: You came in with nothing. That happens more than you'd think.
Take a blade off the bench. Everything else here only changes how the job feels.
npcs.name: Oren the Smith

stock.description: Three-hit chain. The finisher hits hardest and knocks back.
stock.name: Iron Sword

stock.description: Fast arrows with a high critical chance. Keep your distance.
stock.name: Hunter's Bow

lines: Red for blood, blue for the other thing.
Drink standing still if you can. It takes a moment, and a moment is how people die.
npcs.name: Siv the Apothecary

lines: The fire is banked and steady. Rest here and the road stops mattering for a while.
npcs.name: The Hearth

lines: You'll be going north, then. Everyone does, eventually.
My grandfather ploughed to the treeline and no further. Said the wakewood was owed something.
Nobody remembers what. That's the trouble with being owed things for long enough.
npcs.name: Bram

stock.description: Keeps for weeks and tastes like it.
stock.name: Trail Bread

lines: Two ways out of the vale, and I'd take neither if it were up to me.
North is the Rootbridge, into the wakewood. That's where the elder will send you.
East is Stonecount. Follow it far enough and you reach the water, and past that, Emberfall.
npcs.name: Wren of the Watch
